errors.evidence: While the year-over-year increases are larger in this period compared to earlier years, they are significantly smaller than the projected increases for the 2024-2028 period. Singling out the 2017-2023 period is an interpretation that does not fully capture the accelerating trend shown in the chart.

This is a flawed interpretation of the legend. The legend indicates that the green bars represent a data series measured in zettabytes; it does not mean that the color green itself 'corresponds to' the unit.
